post.description: Submit a HAND-FIM job with scenarios and options in the JSON body.

Rerun a retained legacy run's scenarios.json with streaming and diff every scenario.

The job result lists streaming manifests plus per-scenario parity counts; diff GeoTIFFs
(1=legacy-only, 2=streaming-only flooding) and parity/report.json go under output_prefix.

Diff the scenarios shared by two retained results without rerunning HAND-FIM.

Each result may be legacy (<ScenarioID>.cog) or streaming (<ScenarioID>/manifest.json).
The job result lists per-scenario parity counts (legacy_* fields describe the base,
streaming_* the candidate); diff GeoTIFFs (1=base-only, 2=candidate-only flooding)
and parity/report.json go under output_prefix.

delete.description: Revoke queued jobs; the solo worker cannot interrupt a running subprocess.

patch.description: Rename a job in the selected workspace; the immutable job ID is unchanged.

get.description: Read persistent job inputs, timestamps, and outcome in the selected S3 location.
Poll a job's worker output, continuing from the returned next_offset.
Read geographic bounds without downloading the full raster.
Render a 256-pixel inundation tile using range reads against S3.
Bounds and usable zoom range of a streaming scenario's tiled output.
Render a 256-pixel tile combining the streaming scenario's output COG tiles.
Read a retained S3 raster or scenario manifest using the current user's storage permissions.
Render retained output paths independently of job ownership/result TTLs.

base_prefix.description: Output prefix of the base result containing scenarios.json and <ScenarioID>.cog or <ScenarioID>/manifest.json outputs.

candidate_prefix.title: Candidate Prefix
candidate_prefix.description: Output prefix of the result compared against the base.

overwrite.title: Overwrite

CompareJobRequest.title: CompareJobRequest
CompareJobRequest.description: Diff two retained results' scenario flood masks without rerunning HAND-FIM.

skipped_scenarios.title: Skipped Scenarios
skipped_scenarios.description: ScenarioIDs present in only one of the two results.

ComparedResults.title: ComparedResults
ComparedResults.description: The two retained results diffed by a comparison job.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Optional human-readable job name. Duplicate names are allowed; job IDs remain unique.

max_procs.title: Max Procs
max_procs.description: Max concurrent HAND-FIM processes; omit to use the worker's HAND_FIM_MAX_PROCS (default 1).

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace existing S3 objects with matching output keys; by default, conflicting keys fail the job.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: fimserv-2024 downloads whole HUCs and writes one COG per scenario. fimserv-2026 uses the same workflow with NOAA v4.8.14.0 instead of the original pinned code. streaming-2024 range-reads a prepared cloud-optimized hydrofabric per reach and writes tiled COGs plus a manifest per scenario; it requires output_bucket and a single process. streaming-2026 is streaming with NOAA v4.8.14.0's own flood kernel, matching fimserv-2026.

HandFimOutput.title: HandFimOutput
HandFimOutput.description: Metadata for a single generated scenario output.

HandFimParameters.title: HandFimParameters
HandFimParameters.description: The shared scenario JSON schema with worker-specific validation.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: UTC time the worker began executing the job.

finished_at.title: Finished At
finished_at.description: UTC time the worker finished executing the job (success or failure).

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Optional human-readable job name. Duplicate names are allowed; job IDs remain unique.

legacy_prefix.title: Legacy Prefix
legacy_prefix.description: Output prefix of a legacy run containing scenarios.json and <ScenarioID>.cog files.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace existing S3 objects with matching output keys; by default, conflicting keys fail the job.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode

ParityJobRequest.title: ParityJobRequest
ParityJobRequest.description: Rerun a retained legacy run's scenarios with streaming and diff the outputs.

HUC.title: Huc
HUC.description: Hydrologic Unit Code identifying the primary watershed corresponding to the input data. Used to locate the necessary input HAND and rating curve datasets.

ReachID.title: Reachid
ReachID.description: NWM identifier for the river reach corresponding to the input data. Used to process HAND-FIM for the location of interest.

Streamflow.title: Streamflow
Streamflow.description: Streamflow value in cubic meters per second (cms) used as input for the HAND-FIM method. Determines the extent of flooding in the inundation mapping process.

Reach.title: Reach
Reach.description: A single streamflow estimate for a river reach within a watershed.

ScenarioID.title: Scenarioid
ScenarioID.description: Unique identifier for the flood inundation mapping scenario. Also used to define the output file naming.

Reaches.title: Reaches
Reaches.description: List of river reach streamflow entries belonging to this scenario.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description:
A flood inundation mapping scenario.

Groups one or more reach/streamflow entries that are combined into a
single output GeoTIFF.

ScenarioManifest.title: ScenarioManifest
ScenarioManifest.description: A published per-scenario tile manifest from a streaming job.

grid_shift_rows.title: Grid Shift Rows
grid_shift_rows.description: Streaming rows offset from legacy (positive is south); realigned before counting.

grid_shift_columns.title: Grid Shift Columns
grid_shift_columns.description: Streaming columns offset from legacy (positive is east); realigned before counting.

ScenarioParity.title: ScenarioParity
ScenarioParity.description:
Cell-level comparison of one legacy scenario COG against its streaming tiles.

Cell counts are measured after realigning a small whole-pixel grid shift, which
is reported separately and does not affect ``matches``.

peak_memory_bytes.title: Peak Memory Bytes
peak_memory_bytes.description: Sampled peak total worker-container memory while this job ran, in bytes. Concurrent jobs may contribute, short-lived peaks may be missed, and the value is null when cgroup memory metrics are unavailable.

parity.title: Parity
parity.description: Legacy/streaming comparisons; present only for parity and comparison jobs. For comparison jobs legacy_* fields describe the base and streaming_* the candidate.

compared.description: Compared result locations; present only for comparison jobs.

StoredHandFimResult.title: StoredHandFimResult
StoredHandFimResult.description: Successful outputs and the destination persisted by the worker.
